entries.3e80bd4f5aabd1ab: Retail of Meat and Other Products
entries.6c3881418f21a83d: A holding company headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, which, together with six subsidiaries, two affiliates and one parent company (nine affiliated companies in total), forms the group. Its main business is retail sales of meat and other food products, and it also runs a restaurant business. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended January 2026 numbered 753.
entries.933b16d6faf66fa0: This business conducts retail of meat and processed meat products and retail of prepared dishes. The subsidiaries OM Two Meat Co., Ltd., Maruchou Kobeya Co., Ltd. and Ota Sogo Shokuhin Co., Ltd. process and sell meat and processed meat products to general consumers. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥24,850 million, and the number of stores at the end of the consolidated fiscal year was 150 (140 meat retail stores and 10 prepared dish retail stores).
entries.c59db1a6a76aeffe: A business that conducts retail sales of meat and processed meat products and retail sales of prepared dishes.
entries.d35b4a497509e5e9: A business that operates yakiniku restaurants and steak restaurants.
entries.d663b7cd4b39998a: A holding company under S Foods that operates meat specialty retail stores and yakiniku and steak restaurants.
entries.f816c8ed3ae31f11: This business operates yakiniku restaurants and steak restaurants. The subsidiaries Yakiniku no Gyuta Co., Ltd. and Yuwa Co., Ltd. operate yakiniku and shabu-shabu restaurants for general consumers, and OM Two Dining Co., Ltd. operates steak restaurants. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥10,520 million, and the number of stores at the end of the consolidated fiscal year was 47.
